description: Genasis Agents — protocol overlays + commands + hooks (genasis-owned). Base agents are distributed via registry releases, NOT stored here.
note: Base agent .md files are NOT in this directory. They are fetched individually from GitHub Releases by `genasis agents install`. See index.json for the browseable catalog.

contents.overlays: Plane/MM protocol patches (.tera) injected into agent files via marker fences
contents.commands: Slash command templates for Claude Code
contents.hooks: Git/session hooks for sprint protocol enforcement
contents.index.json: Agent registry metadata (names, descriptions, categories, tags) — NO .md content

base_format: plain_md (fetched from registry, not stored here)
